stdout:
Set a channel watermark. Use this tool to set a channel watermark.

Usage:
  yutu watermark set [flags]

Examples:
# Set a watermark for a channel
yutu watermark set --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --file watermark.png
# Set a watermark with position and offset
yutu watermark set --channelId UC_x5X --file logo.png --inVideoPosition bottomRight --offsetType offsetFromEnd --offsetMs 1000
# Set a watermark with duration
yutu watermark set --channelId UC_x5X --file logo.png --durationMs 5000 --offsetMs 2000

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                ID of the channel
  -d, --durationMs uint                 Duration in milliseconds for which the watermark should be displayed
  -f, --file string                     Path to the watermark file
  -h, --help                            help for set
  -p, --inVideoPosition string          topLeft|topRight|bottomLeft|bottomRight
  -m, --offsetMs uint                   Defines the time at which the watermark will appear
  -t, --offsetType string               offsetFromStart|offsetFromEnd
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
